title: Sisi Orders Expansion of Data Centers, 5G and AI as Egypt Targets $12B in Digital Outsourcing Exports by 2029
detail: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi met Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, Communications and IT Minister Raafat Hendi, and Armed Forces Signal Corps director Maj. Gen. Hany Mahmoud Mansour on September 19, 2026, directing the government to accelerate investment in hyper-scale data centers, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and nationwide 5G rollout. Officials outlined targets of $8 billion in digital exports by 2028 and $12 billion in digital outsourcing exports by 2029, alongside growing the number of electronics-design companies to 120 by 2030. The discussions also covered advancing 'Karnak,' Egypt's national program for Arabic-language generative AI positioned as part of a digital sovereignty strategy, expansion of the unified government services card, and new child-safety measures including social media restrictions for users under 13.

media.caption: Sisi meets PM Madbouly and IT Minister Hendi on Egypt's digital expansion plan
